objective: Gate4E-R8 preflight READ_ONLY del diseño R7 antes de cualquier mutacion. Auditar los puntos exactos de implementacion para ClienteID explicito, UUID Comandero estable, transporte por rafagas, receptor HUB /v1/sync/transaccion, resolucion canonica Empresa/Unidad/Sucursal, correlacion POS nativa hacia Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto y contrato fisico de dbo.RRR_Eventos. Clasificar REUSE/EXTEND/ADD/DO_NOT_TOUCH y detectar cualquier colision arquitectonica. No modificar codigo, no DDL, no DML, no Customer360 V3, no Production.

queries.name: r8_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: r8_rrr_eventos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: r8_rrr_eventos_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: r8_rrr_eventos_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.object_id=fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fkc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: r8_comercial_detail_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto') AND LOWER(c.name) IN ('numero_ticket','id_transaccion','folio_origen','documento_origen','fecha_operacion','cancelado_origen','es_kpi_valido','sistema_origen','unidad_negocio_id','unidad_negocio_pk','sucursal_id','empresa_id') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: r8_comercial_native_key_sample
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (50) sistema_origen,numero_ticket,id_transaccion,folio_origen,fecha_operacion,cancelado_origen,es_kpi_valido FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE es_kpi_valido=1 ORDER BY fecha_operacion DESC

queries.name: r8_cliente_pk
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Cliente_Catalogo') AND c.name='ClienteID'

queries.name: r8_canonical_org_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Empresas') AND c.name='EmpresaID') OR (c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Unidades_Negocio') AND c.name='id') OR (c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sucursales') AND c.name='SucursalID') ORDER BY object_name,column_name
